findings.summary: The 8.3 fix still trusts session-lifetime AbsentDir and empty-directory snapshots. Because local apply runs concurrently while later 128-entry chunks are still being diffed, an earlier chunk can create a long-name file and its 8.3 alias after the snapshot; a later source entry using that alias is still reported Absent rather than sent to authoritative stat, so it is planned and can overwrite the earlier file, including under --ignore-existing. A Windows probe using a real custom short name reproduced the stale Absent verdict.
